name: Orb · Bitdumb
description: Nested binary grids shuttering on a tumbling bit-sphere: a twenty-level power-of-two zoom wrapped onto the ball through a stereographic projection, cell edges drawn with an analytic pixel footprint instead of fwidth, and an animated per-cell shutter that lets each grid level occlude the ones beneath (WebGL). Ported from Orbkit shdr-28 — shader by XorDev, non-commercial.
